beats.say: Two nights weekly: Claudia Winkleman leads Celebrity Traitors return
The second series of The Celebrity Traitors aired every Thursday and Friday night.
First arriving on BBC One on 8 October 2025, the hit social deduction show returns to Scotland.
Famous faces step inside to play a high stakes game of trust, deception and secret roles.
Contestants take part in tactical challenges while trying to unmask hidden traitors among faithful players.
Every tense banishment and murder leads to one huge final result for a chosen charity prize.
Setting celebrity stars against each other transforms simple party games into top tier television entertainment. Who was your favourite traitor or faithful this series?

facts: A second series began broadcasting on 1 October 2026, every Thursday and Friday night, and will continue to until 30 October.
The Celebrity Traitors was first broadcast on BBC One on 8 October 2025.
The show features a group of celebrity contestants participating in a social deduction game set in Ardross Castle in Scotland.
The grand prize is awarded to a charity of the winner's choice.
